title: Length of Last Word
statement_short: Given a string s consisting of words and spaces, return the length of the last word in s. A word is a maximal substring consisting of non-space characters only.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 10^4, s consists of English letters and spaces ' ', s contains at least one word
hint: String length up to 10^4 allows an O(n) reverse scan, skipping trailing spaces then counting word characters.
why_not: Right: Two Pointers (or reverse linear scan) skips trailing space characters and counts consecutive letter characters in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Sliding Window: Finding the last word requires scanning backward from the end rather than managing a forward sliding subsegment. Not Stack: Pushing characters or words onto a stack uses O(n) extra memory needlessly. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Word lookup tables are irrelevant for a simple string index traversal.
